evals.name: atomic-multi-repository-write
evals.prompt: Execute a business transaction writing through User, Account, and Audit repositories atomically.
evals.expected_output: Unit of Work pattern executing all three repository writes inside a single atomic transaction scope.
assertions: Coordinates multiple repositories within one Unit of Work execution context.
Commits only when all repository operations succeed.
Rolls back all repository writes if any single operation fails.

evals.name: database-agnostic-uow-port
evals.prompt: Define a UnitOfWork port interface in hexagonal architecture that domain usecases can invoke.
evals.expected_output: A domain-level UnitOfWork interface with an Execute(ctx, func(repoProvider) error) error method.
assertions: Port interface lives in domain/usecase layer and does not import sql or driver packages.
Provides repository instances bound to the transaction inside the closure.
Decouples domain orchestration from SQL transaction primitives.

evals.name: rollback-on-panic
evals.prompt: A panic occurs inside a UnitOfWork transaction callback. Ensure the database transaction is not left open.
evals.expected_output: UnitOfWork adapter recovering from panic, rolling back transaction, and re-panicking.
assertions: Uses recover() in defer block within UnitOfWork execution adapter.
Executes transaction rollback before propagating panic.
Re-panics with original value to preserve stack trace and crash behavior.
